title: Terminals belong to clusters, not windows
context: Terminals live in a band under the tool window, drawn inside the cluster's half. A terminal window-scoped would show the wrong worktree when switching clusters.
decision: Terminal scope follows the drawing: a terminal belongs to the cluster whose band holds it, spawns in that cluster's project, killed with cluster.
consequences: Opening a terminal to work on one branch and finding it still there when switching to another branch is impossible. Cross-cluster shells stay expressible by putting cluster on its own monitor or dragging terminal into a pane.
